summary: Bilia AB (publ) operates as a full-service supplier for car ownership in Sweden, Norway, Luxembourg, and Belgium. The company operates through Service, Car, and Fuel segments. It provides service, repair, fuel, car wash, rental cars, wheel and tyres, rim repair, car accessories, car care, paint work, glass repair and replacement and repair, car accessories, and other services. The company also offers car servicing and repair, spare parts, and wheel storage. In addition, it provides washing and refueling services under the Tanka, OKQ8, and Tvätta brands. The company is also involved in the sale of new and used cars; transport vehicles and trucks; and offers financing, insurance, and other services. The company sells cars from Volvo, BMW, MINI, Toyota, Lexus, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Nissan, Jaguar, Land Rover, XPENG, Volkswagen, Audi, Skoda, Seat, Cupra, and other brands; transport vehicles from Toyota, Mercedes-Benz, Nissan, and Volkswagen; and trucks from Mercedes-Benz. Additionally, it operates an internet-based auction site in Sweden; and sells its products through stores and online. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden.
